scope: Static review of completed RBM preparation snapshots; no cloud access or workload execution.

disk_api_receipt.interpretation: Capacity and advertised performance changed. All new paired performance must use the expanded disk; do not combine absolute timings with the old 160GiB campaign. Old correctness evidence retains its original hardware identity.

preparation_snapshot.container_net_diff: Compared to corrected-runtime-preparation-review-04: only record_scene_capacity, the invalid marker admission check, and calls before and after each scene. FIO workload, strict drain, and remote durability logic are unchanged.

guard_review.inode_preflight: 100000 reserved, then at least total_inodes / 5 remain
guard_review.scene_boundaries: Both before_scene and after_scene require at least 20 percent free bytes and inodes; persist JSONL and an invalid marker on failure.
guard_review.monitor: Host statvfs sampled every approximately 2 seconds; a low sample invalidates the arm and stops only the current Compose project's perf service.
guard_review.final_validation: Requires all twelve distinct scene/phase rows for six scenes, all passed, no invalid marker, qualified host receipt, and no owned remaining containers.
guard_review.limits: 256GiB is an empirical planning reserve, not a demonstrated upper bound. Sampling and boundary checks do not establish an exact continuous minimum or peak.
